##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 08 July 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure west of Iberia, extending a ridge over Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

Variable or between South and Southwest 2 or 3, possibly occasionally 4 in a few places for a time tonight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but a risk of mist and fog patches tonight and at first tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 1 to 3, settling mainly North or Northwest 2 to 4.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
